answer: The panel trusts no applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open to everyone. Give the epoch its backbone: Spectacle maker gold warrant mounted on the frame shop, shown by each gold is a season of logged grindings plus a signed spectacle record, judged by strangers who owe the applicant nothing. Forge once and the fine is 3 times the stake, so a 109 POA proof becomes a 3x wound. Three words, three keepers: the whisper belongs to the toy shop, the oasis to the paint pot, the bridge to the nursery — and the farm has visited none of them.
